mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees under clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a full moon visible tonight. You can also catch the space station at 7:44 PM as it travels from the northwest over Verona High School toward the southeast over Festival Foods. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

For city updates, please note that a section of Highway M will be closed to traffic from October 5 through October 7 to allow for final road surfacing work. Additionally, crews begin fall leaf collection on October 5, so please remember to keep piles loose and off the street.

There is plenty to do in Verona today with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, along with the popular Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market takes place downtown, followed by live music at Paddy Mac's.
A noteworthy incident occurred on September 5, when officers responded to reports of cheese being placed on vehicle windshields throughout the city as part of a viral social media prank.
Culver's is closed today for a facility remodel. We look forward to them reopening tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when the featured flavor of the day will be OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
